design_notes: Use serif type throughout; single accent colour (e.g., steel blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Hairline rules between table rows; bold top rule for table header.
Pull-quote set in larger serif italic, with a thin rule above and below, no quotation marks.
Sidebar set in a box with a thin border, slightly smaller type, placed after the 'offer' section.

pull_quotes.quote: The top 10 clients accounted for 92.61% of sales, and the top 5 contributed more than 75%.

sidebars.body_markdown: The offer size, breakdown between fresh issue and offer for sale, and price band are not disclosed in the available pages of the DRHP. The lead manager is Share India Capital Services Private Limited [^drhp-p42] and the registrar is Skyline Financial Services Private Limited [^drhp-p42]. Because the issue size is less than ₹10,000 lakh (₹100 crore), no independent monitoring agency will be appointed to oversee the deployment of funds [^drhp-p27].
sidebars.rationale: Sidebar consolidates all offer-related disclosures in one place, compensating for missing data.
sidebars.title: The offer at a glance
